title: Constrain a route number
summary: ASP.NET Core: Constrain a route number. Try /double/cat.
introduction: The int route constraint only matches whole numbers. Open GET /double/4.
learningObjectives: Constrain a route number with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Constrain a route number

blocks.text: The int constraint matches 4. Binding supplies an int and the handler doubles it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A failed route constraint usually means this route does not match.
